demo.bio:
I'm a photographer and filmmaker who believes the best pictures happen when nobody is posing. For over ten years I've documented weddings, families and brands with a calm, natural eye.

Every session is a collaboration: we talk, we plan, and then I disappear into the background so the real moments can unfold.

faq.title: A few things you might wonder.

trial.q: Can I try Lumodesk before paying?
trial.a: Yes. Every plan begins with a 14-day free trial, with no credit card required.

migrate.q: Can I migrate my existing clients?
migrate.a: Absolutely. Import contacts, projects, and contracts from a CSV, or let our concierge team handle it.

galleries.a: Every plan includes beautiful, mobile-ready galleries. Storage limits vary by plan.

commission.a: Never. Payments go directly to your connected account, with no Lumodesk commission.

team.q: Can my team use the same workspace?
team.a: Studio plans include five seats, granular permissions, and shared workflow templates.
